text: for some reason your file menus are completely decoupled from the action bar [Image #1]
resolution: Fixed the hmsc-workspace-mock menu/action-bar coupling. Added explicit actionMenu mock state so choosing a top menu drives both the dropdown and action bar. The top menu highlight now follows the active action menu, and ToolOptions renders commands from the same menu-scoped command registry as the dropdown instead of a separate tool-only list. Action bar buttons execute or arm those exact menu commands, so File/Edit/View/etc. no longer show unrelated Build tools. Verified with BUNDLE_FROM_HARNESS=1 tools/v8cli scripts/cart-bundle.js cart/hmsc-workspace-mock/index.tsx --out /tmp/hmsc-workspace-mock.bundle.js and SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship hmsc-workspace-mock.
